Section headings rendered at two sizes: AppModal's shared title uses roles.sectionTitle (16) while five hand-rolled headings use this scalar. Raising the scalar to 16 aligns all six on one size without editing any byte-frozen screen or modal file. The duplication between this scalar and roles.sectionTitle.fontSize stays until the feature freeze lifts and the call sites can migrate to the role.

A card title matched its own body copy at 13px, so cards carried no internal hierarchy. 14px separates the title without reaching the 16px section tier. No fixed-height text container exists in the app to clip it (verified by AST scan).

Control labels sat in the 12px floor band alongside meta and micro copy, which put every primary CTA label at the smallest size in the system. 13px lifts the label the user must act on out of the caption tier. Consumers are AppButton, OptionChips, SegmentedControl and four screens, all with flexible height.

normalizedPaths.reason: Accessibility-only change, committed in eddbc55. It now carries accessibilityRole and a Turkish label. Screen reader metadata does not render, so layout, content, styling and state topology are unchanged.
